name: Trouble Shooting Assistance
brief: Real-time multi-user database change capture and analysis for Business Central
description: Troubleshooting Assistance captures, groups, and analyses database changes in real time across all active sessions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Target a specific user, filter by table, and replay transaction sequences to diagnose data-flow issues, validate business logic, and investigate multi-user concurrency behaviour — without modifying base objects.
